name: Corrupt Manifestation's Bracers
summary: On Silverpine Forest’s coast, Corrupt Manifestation's Bracers remain from a corrupted water elemental. During the Call of Water, shaman initiates cast them into the Brazier of Everfount with pure water, cleansing the shrine and summoning a pure water spirit.

sections.title: A Cleansing Offering
sections.body: The Scourge’s plague reached Lordaeron’s spirits. Along Silverpine Forest’s coast, west of the Sepulcher, corruption overcame a sacred water shrine. Its water manifestation became an aggressive shade, and shaman initiates must defeat it to recover the bracers. At the Brazier of Everfount, they cast the bindings into the flame with pure water. The rite lifts the shrine’s corruption and calls forth an unblemished water spirit.

faq.q: What are these bracers used for?
faq.answer: During a cleansing rite, the bracers are cast into the Brazier of Everfount with pure water. This purges corruption from the Silverpine shrine and calls forth a pure water spirit.

faq.q: Where do the bracers come from?
faq.answer: The bracers come from a Corrupt Minor Manifestation of Water near a tainted elemental shrine on the Silverpine Forest coast, west of the Sepulcher.

faq.q: Why did the water elemental become corrupt?
faq.answer: The plague and dark powers that blighted Lordaeron warped the elemental and severed the local spirits from communion with shamans.

angles.text: As a shaman, you recover and purify these bracers as the final trial of the Call of Water. The trial proves your power to soothe and restore distorted elements.
